doc:
### PROPOSAL-20 — 1-Bit Dither - **slug**: `1bit-dither` - **Vibe**: A Macintosh-classic or Game Boy camera screen — pure black and pure white, with every shade faked by Bayer-dither dot patterns. No grays exist. - **Best for**: Power-user tables, agency publishing logs, and any surface that should look like 1991 portable hardware. Adjectives: austere, mechanical, print-like. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f4f1ea` | Paper-white LCD backdrop | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Pure white panel | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#f4f1ea` | Dither-pattern panel (50% checker) | | `--border-subtle` | `#d8d4c8` | Hairline (rendered as 1px dotted) | | `--border-default` | `#000000` | Pure black borders | | `--border-focus` | `#000000` | Black focus outline (double-strike) | | `--text-primary` | `#000000` | Pure black text | | `--text-secondary` | `#000000` | Black text at 70% dither (pattern) | | `--text-muted` | `#000000` | Black text at 30% dither (pattern) | | `--color-action` | `#000000` | Black primary fills (white text) | | `--color-action-hover` | `#000000` | Hover = inverted (black↔white) | | `--color-earnings` | `#000000` | Black + 50% dither highlight | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#000000` | Hover = solid black | | `--color-automation` | `#000000` | Black + 25% dither accents | | `--color-alert` | `#000000` | Black, blinking 1Hz | | `--color-danger` | `#000000` | Black, inverted field | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)` | 6% checker tint (only "glow") | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)` | 6% checker tint | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)` | 6% checker tint | - **Typography**: Bitmap-flavored system: Display: `"Silkscreen", "Pixelify Sans", monospace` for headings. Body: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace`. Uppercase labels, `letter-spacing: 0.06em`. No font-weight games — hierarchy via dither density and size only. KPIs `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Zero radius anywhere. Borders are 1-3px solid black; the 2px "double border" (outer 2px + inner 1px with 2px gap) marks selected/active surfaces, like classic Mac chrome. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Rectangular, 2px black border. Primary = solid black with white text; hover inverts to outline style. Active = shifted 2px down-right with the shadow collapsing (classic Mac press). Focus = 2px black outline with 2px gap. - **Cards**: White panels with 2px black border and a 4px hard offset black shadow; "elevated" surfaces use a 50% Bayer checker pattern instead of a lighter gray. - **Badges/Status**: Square chips: filled black = active, 50% dither = pending, outline only = done. Status dot is a 4x4px black square. Blinking = attention. - **Tables**: 1px black grid, header row uses the 25% dither pattern as its background. Row hover = full-row dither wash. Numbers right-aligned mono. - **Forms/Inputs**: White field, 2px black border, block cursor. Focus = double-strike border (3px). Disabled = 50% dither text. - **Loading**: A marching-ants border (animated dashed outline) or a classic watch-cursor alternation. Determinate = black bar filling in 8px "pixel" steps. - **Signature detail**: Bayer-dither patterns standing in for every gray — squint and you get shades; look close and there are only two colors. - **Motion & Animation**: Stepped and frame-based: 80-120ms, `steps(4)` easing, no sub-pixel movement — things jump in 2px increments like a low-DPI screen. Blinking is a hard on/off at 1-2Hz. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS/30D $12,480 +14.2%
```
